title: A new probabilistic approach for mean field games of optimal stopping
summary: We propose a novel probabilistic formulation for optimal stopping mean field games (OS-MFGs) with randomized strategies. We characterize mean field equilibria through a new class of coupled forward-backward systems, termed coupled reflected forward-backward McKean--Vlasov stochastic differential equations (MKV-RFBSDEs). An equilibrium is represented by a quintuple $(X,Y,Z,A,L)$, where $L$ is an adapted, $[0,1]$-valued, non-increasing càdlàg process representing the randomized stopping strategy.
